_about: Thomas M'Crie (1772-1835), the Scottish church historian: The Life of John Knox, in the new edition edited by his son Thomas M'Crie the younger (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1873), The Life of Andrew Melville (Edinburgh: Blackwood, 1819, 2 vols, the first edition), and his histories of the Reformation in Italy and in Spain (Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1842 reprints of the Edinburgh editions). Volume numbers read off the title pages. The surname check matches 'Crie' as a word, because the OCR prints the prefix as M', M‘ or Mc. Added 2026-10-03, two books by his son Thomas M'Crie the younger (1797-1875), which the name check finds just as well: the Sketches of Scottish Church History from the Reformation to the Revolution (6th ed., Edinburgh: Johnstone, 1849, two volumes bound as one; a Google scan, and Google asks non-commercial use, noted) and the Life of Thomas M'Crie, D.D. (Philadelphia, 1842). Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
